Contents

On this page

Everyone in these photographs has agreed to appear. The wiki is archived and stays public, so nothing here carries a face, a name or a location that its subject has not cleared.

How this page is filled

Photographs come from iGEM2026_Images, filed by month. The naming convention is in that folder's README. Before the freeze they have to be re-hosted on static.igem.wiki, because the wiki blocks images served from anywhere else.

The year in photographs

A month-by-month grid. Add each month as its own block once the photographs for it are chosen and cleared.
